notes.title: We are happy to announce the release date for CYGNI
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the release date for CYGNI: All Guns Blazing 6th of August 2024!
In case you missed our exciting news during the IGN Live event on June 8th, you can check out the interview with KeelWorks CEO Meher Kalenderian and KONAMI team, featuring exclusive new gameplay footage and brand-new CG trailer that we revealed below:

[previewyoutube=yY3NQmGDIXQ;full][/previewyoutube]

You can now pre-order digitally with 10% off on all platforms and exclusive to Steam, you can also pre-order a bundle with the Original Soundtrack Music

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/754a73e66d1ea957d405f752620fd67a6138c748.png[/img]

Make sure to follow us on our social media page to keep up with all the announcements and updates!

notes.title: Demo Feedback and Updates on Changes Made
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who played our Demo during the February 2024 Steam Next Fest and shared their feedback. We have listened and made some changes! To find out more, check out the video below narrated by Game Director, Nareg Kalenderian. 

[previewyoutube=0rbOGsmbSzM;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is a summary of all the updates: 
The tutorial button on the main page now has a new colour. Some players were not able to view the button. 

Ship Speed: 
[list]
[*] The analog stick now has full-range support for ship speed. 
[*] You can now adjust speed sensitivity from the options menu.   
[*] The D-pad controls now behave correctly for better micro-movements, such as dodging.   
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/78eb6f22f371535fb386486c7eca8246a5497b34.png[/img]

Ground Weapon: 
[list]
[*] Re-written the targeting system to make it more intuitive and easier to manage. 
[*] Combine two buttons into one.  
[*] Auto-fire + Auto Target 
[*] Switch back and forth between manual control and auto target when needed. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/1591d76d500d93761dafbec0f844639348b47526.gif[/img]

HUD : 
Players can now adjust ship HUD size from the options menu for better visibility.  
You now have the option to enable an additional HUD display at the bottom of the screen.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/f39209be7dab6470bc1c26348ab40298e7565ad9.png[/img]

Auto-fire now available as a real-time toggle – you can assign a button in the control’s menu.  

Revive/Continue Mechanic – only available for Easy mode:
This will only be available in the easy mode. Players will have three lives per level and will be revived in the same spot instead of restarting the level (at the cost of pickups and score being reset per revive for that stage only). This can be used throughout the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/22bfd302eca94fcfc9e4367d6f7aeb2e02ef36cd.gif[/img]

Invert function for stick controllers (Mainly for left-handed players): 
In the gamepad options menu, the player can toggle the checkbox to invert the stick controllers. This will swap the left and right stick functionality.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37755147/fd227212a9546e07ee2b7e5d536b4fa365fd3a90.png[/img]

Overall Balancing :
We have further balanced the game based on feedback, which will better reflect on the different difficulty modes. 

Steam Deck :
Currently in the works, keep an eye out for future updates on this. 

For future updates and announcements, make sure you are following us on our socials!

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h3]While our initial goal was to release CYGNI: All Guns Blazing this year, and despite our utmost dedication, we find ourselves in need of a little more time for testing and polishing. Therefore, we’re pushing the release to 2024 to ensure we reach the quality we aspire to achieve.

We’ll keep you updated on our progress in the coming few months and look forward to sharing more at Tokyo Game Show 2023 this week.

Thanks to CYGNI fans for all the continued support and patience, we're almost there and won’t keep you waiting long!


Follow the CYGNI social channels on Twitter and Facebook for all the latest news and info on the game.[/h3]
